primary_question: Which measured limitations explain the absence of a confirmed policy-quality gain, and which at most two controlled follow-up branches are justified?
protected_scope: historical V1-panel_tools.1 source, checkpoints, reports, and artifacts

common_open_panel.role: descriptive common comparison only; previously opened

rm_fit.role: historical RM fitting rows; temporal validity to be checked

rm_development.role: must be fixed from permitted pre-audit pool before any C model selection

external_audit.role: frozen after model/branch freeze; never selection

metrics.primary: existing user-macro NDCG@10, original positive/nonorganic/OOV/tie definitions
metrics.user_aggregation: Aggregate events within user; average method scores across fixed seeds before paired user bootstrap.
metrics.guard: One-sided 95% lower bound of user-level metric_policy - 0.98 * metric_reference; report separately from two-sided paired-difference CI.
metrics.checkpoint: Existing run last.pt primary; best.pt separate; step-0 identity fallback is never a trained checkpoint.
metrics.full_catalog: Preserve catalog 20k, top support K=500, ratio objective, and unchanged reference tail.

registered_contrasts: sampled_loo - exact_expected_reward separately at beta 1.0 and 0.3
analytic_q_distillation - exact_expected_reward separately at beta 1.0 and 0.3
trained no_feedback - full separately by seed at beta 0.3
branch_selection_rule: Use only fixed train/development evidence and diagnostics B/C. The 6655 panel, 710 retrospective final, and external audit are descriptive endpoints after the model list is frozen.
pre_scoring_temporal_gate: Determine row-wise event-time validity of actor, RM, and prior features before including any policy-quality comparison; report exclusions and common eligible panel.
